{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit crew-neck sweater, slim cut, hip length, deep burgundy #5B1F2A, merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, mid-rise, full length to the ankle bone, black #1C1C1E, stretch wool-blend crepe
Classic jacket with a small collar, cropped at the hip, black #141414, smooth lambskin leather
Ankle boots, low stacked block heel, round toe, black #111111, matte leather with a grippy rubber sole
Small crossbody bag, compact rectangular shape, worn across the body, black #1A1A1A, grained leather
Small round stud earrings, silver #C0C0C0, polished sterling silver

This outfit sits at a neat, restrained level while still nodding to the rock-concert setting. The burgundy knit adds depth and warmth against the black, and the leather jacket gives a classic rock edge without looking like a costume. For standing in a crowd for hours, the trousers keep you covered, the low block heel is stable, and the crossbody bag leaves your hands free and stays safe in a crush.
